claim_text: Our CCAP includes actions to reduce our operational emissions to mitigate transition risk and protect value, and to support emissions reduction across our value chains.
metric_name: CCAP publication; Worsley Alumina Scope 1 reduction; Scope 3 emissions FY25
context_text: We have published our second Climate Change Action Plan (CCAP).；Our CCAP includes actions to reduce our operational emissions ... and to support emissions reduction across our value chains.；In FY25, our conversion of two boilers from coal to gas at Worsley Alumina contributed to a 12% reduction in Worsley Alumina’s Scope 1 emissions and a 4.2% reduction in total Scope 1 emissions, both relative to FY21 levels.；In FY25, Scope 3 emissions totalled 22.7 Mt CO2-e, 58% lower than FY24 levels.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: 报告明确表明已发布CCAP，并列出与运营排放和价值链排放相关的行动及若干实际进展，足以支持“CCAP includes actions”这一表述。
notes: 该主张重点在“包含行动”，非声称已全面实现减排。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the company’s CCAP includes actions that will reduce operational emissions (to mitigate transition risk/protect value) and support emissions reductions across its value chains. The provided evidence fields only state “published” (CCAP publication status), a “Worsley Alumina Scope 1 reduction” of “12% / 4.2%” (unclear which figure applies, what baseline/timeframe, and whether it is an achieved reduction or a target), and “Scope 3 emissions FY25: 22.7 Mt CO2-e” (a level, not a reduction or evidence of actions). There is no substantive evidence describing the CCAP actions, showing that operational emissions reductions are being delivered, or demonstrating support for emissions reduction across the value chain; the transition-risk/value-protection causal claims are also not evidenced.
